title: Prismatic Platform export contract — one JSON Schema per NDJSON line
$comment: docs/adr/prismatic-platform-integration.md, Fáze 2.2 of docs/missions/2026-08-05-prismatic-platform-integration-master-prompt.md. This schema validates ONE record (one line of the provider's NDJSON output), not the whole file — scripts/prismatic/lib/contract.mjs applies it per line. Major-version compatibility is enforced in code (unknown MAJOR is a hard rejection before this schema even runs), not expressible as a JSON Schema constraint. No field here is ever a truth/confidence score presented as a published fact — 'confidence' is explicitly internal-only, mirroring AGENTS.md's own no-truth-rating rule for vomaste's public JSON-LD.

contract_version.$comment: MAJOR.MINOR. A consumer must reject an unknown MAJOR outright (contract.mjs), not via this pattern alone.

record_id.$comment: Stable within a run_id — used for idempotent import/dedup.

prismatic_commit.$comment: Required in practice for any record_type except run_manifest's own bootstrap line, enforced in contract.mjs (JSON Schema alone can't express 'required unless record_type is X' cleanly here without duplicating the whole oneOf).

subject_ref.$comment: Local vomaste entity/dossier identifier this record is about, when applicable.

capability.$comment: Which Prismatic capability produced this record, e.g. 'ares-lookup' — must correspond to a row in docs/audits/2026-08-05-prismatic-capability-map.md marked 'reuse directly', never an unaudited or rejected one.

confidence.$comment: Internal metadata ONLY. AGENTS.md 'Prismatic Platform as an upstream capability provider': this may generate a candidate or point to evidence, but is never itself published as a factual finding or a truth score.

payload.$comment: record_type-specific structured data (proposed entity fields, proposed claim text, etc.). Deliberately loose here — validated more specifically once a concrete first capability (ARES lookup) is wired in Fáze 2.4+, to avoid speculatively shaping fields for capabilities that were rejected/unverified in the Fáze 0 audit.
